messages:
Maya: Thanks everyone for the all-hands today — quick thread to capture the follow-up Qs about API / Console / Optimize timelines. I'll let Jordan summarize the product commitments we mentioned.
Jordan: TL;DR: short roadmap + dates we committed to in the demo. High level: API improvements (streaming reliability + function calling fixes) -> late May beta; Console UX changes (route grouping, cost drilldowns) -> early June beta; Optimize recommendations (quantization suggestion engine + workload profiler) -> phased rollouts starting mid-June.
Priya: Can you clarify what 'beta' means for Console? Is it opt-in in org settings or cohort-based?
Jordan: Good q — Console beta = opt-in toggle per org. We'll open to 10% of orgs first for the safety checks, then 100% after telemetry looks good. Cohort selection will prioritize orgs flagged as internal-stage or high-engagement.
Anil: From runtime side, Optimize's profiler needs a lightweight agent to collect sequence length distribution + latency per model. We plan a small telemetry collector that runs in the gateway and emits aggregated buckets. Non-PII only.
Sam: Regarding rollouts — we will use canary routing by default. Plan: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error-rate or latency regression. Ops will publish the exact SLO checks tomorrow.
Elena: A few enterprise customers asked about Dedicated / Private compatibility with Optimize recommendations (we promised to support on-prem). Timeline?
Jordan: Dedicated: we'll ship the recommendation engine (exportable JSON + CLI apply) in the mid-June phase. Private (VPC/on-prem): target is July for an enabled-but-manual flow (customers can run the profiler binary and upload results to their control plane).
Priya: Any docs or migration playbooks planned for Console changes? I want to prep the quickstart + changelog.
Jordan: Yes — docs team will add a migration guide and a 'what changed' checklist. Target docs publish: one week before beta starts.
Maya: Action items: Jordan to post canonical timeline + feature toggle names; Priya to draft quickstart & changelog; Anil to share minimal profiler spec; Sam to post SLO thresholds. Please add owners in thread.
Jordan: I'll post the canonical timeline here by EOD. For visibility: timeline snippet below (subject to minor shifts):
```
- API: streaming reliability & function-calls fixes — Beta: 2025-05-28, GA: 2025-07-10
- Console: route grouping + cost drilldowns — Beta: 2025-06-05, GA: 2025-07-22
- Optimize: profiler + quantization suggestions — Phase 1 (recommendations export): 2025-06-15, Phase 2 (auto-apply w/ safety): 2025-08-01
```
Priya: Thanks — that helps. I'll pair with Docs tomorrow.
Anil: Will share profiler spec in this thread by EOD; minimal schema + retention config.
Sam: I'll post the SLO gate values and canary playbook in #eng-oncall after I sync with infra.
Elena: Any plan to surface a migration calendar to customers (Customer Success)? If we have dates we can announce a window.
Jordan: Yes, CS can use the dates above. We'll also prepare a short email template and release notes para.
Maya: Great. One more ask — product wants one sample command for customers to run the profiler locally. Priya / Anil, can you make a 1-liner?
Anil: Example CLI for profiler (still WIP): 
```
redwood-profiler run --model gpt-3-compat --duration 1h --output profile-2025-06.json
```
Priya: I'll convert that to a quickstart snippet with expected output and error troubleshooting.
Jordan: I'll update the roadmap doc and ping this thread when done. Thanks all. :rocket:
deploy-bot: New doc published: https://intra.redwood/release-notes/allhands-2025-05-12 (auto-generated)
Maya: Perfect — closing this follow-up. If anything slips, please call it out asap so CS & sales can coordinate messaging. :handshake:
